The worst-case dense instance (512 windows × 256 slots, 127k arcs) takes 22 s and verifies. That's within budget for one epoch but two such epochs would be 44 s; plus the batch could have more. Let's profile where the time goes and optimize.

Let me instrument: time the ratio search (11 max-flows), the optimise (512 Dijkstras), the potentials, and the verification.

Let me add a profiling mode.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 -c "
import json, random, sys, time, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import perf, controller, planlib, probability, valid
raw = json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[perf.wide_case()]}).encode()
obj = valid.parse(raw); cases = valid.validate(obj)
c = cases[0]
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable()
res, ok = controller.plan_case(c)
pr.disable()
s=io.StringIO(); ps=pstats.Stats(pr,stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative'); ps.print_stats(14); print(s.getvalue())
" 2>&1 | head -40
